name: Canonical Negotiation & Offer Engine — Offer Strategy, Counteroffers, Concessions & Contract Decision

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const eventType=String(b.eventType??b.type??'offer_event').trim().toLowerCase(); const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const sellerId=String(b.sellerId??b.ownerId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const idempotencyKey=String(b.idempotencyKey??('negotiation:'+eventType+':'+leadId+':'+dealId+':'+(b.responseId??b.counterofferId??b.offerId??''))).trim(); return [{json:{...b,eventType,leadId,propertyId,dealId,sellerId,portfolioId,idempotencyKey,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Negotiation Event').first().json; const c=$json.context??$json; const n=x=>Number.isFinite(Number(x))?Number(x):0; const event=String(input.eventType).toLowerCase(); const protectedMao=n(c.protectedMao??c.recommendedMao); const currentOffer=n(c.currentOffer??input.currentOffer); const sellerCounter=n(c.counterofferAmount??input.counterofferAmount); const sellerAccepted=event==='accepted'||event==='accept'||input.accepted===true; const sellerRejected=event==='rejected'||event==='reject'; const dnc=event==='dnc'||c.dnc===true; const closed=['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(c.dealStatus??'').toLowerCase()); const round=n(c.negotiationRound??input.negotiationRound??0); const maxRounds=Math.max(1,n(c.maxNegotiationRounds??input.maxNegotiationRounds??5)); const motivation=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,n(c.motivationScore??input.motivationScore))); const risk=String(c.riskLevel??input.riskLevel??'medium').toLowerCase(); const candidate=sellerCounter>0?sellerCounter:currentOffer; const gap=protectedMao>0?candidate-protectedMao:0; const utilization=protectedMao>0?candidate/protectedMao:0; const flags=[]; let decision='human_review'; let action='review_negotiation'; let nextOffer=currentOffer; if(dnc){decision='do_not_contact';action='suppress_negotiation';flags.push('dnc');} else if(closed){decision='blocked';action='no_action';flags.push('protected_deal_state');} else if(sellerAccepted){decision='contract_ready';action='advance_to_contract_readiness';nextOffer=currentOffer;} else if(sellerRejected){decision=motivation>=60?'reengage_later':'walk_away';action=motivation>=60?'schedule_reengagement':'close_negotiation';} else if(sellerCounter>0){ if(protectedMao<=0){decision='human_review';action='validate_protected_mao';flags.push('missing_protected_mao');} else if(sellerCounter<=protectedMao){ if(round>=maxRounds){decision='human_review';action='final_negotiation_review';flags.push('max_rounds_reached');} else if(sellerCounter<=currentOffer||currentOffer<=0){decision='accept_or_contract';action='accept_counter_and_prepare_contract';nextOffer=sellerCounter;} else {const concession=Math.min(Math.max(0,(sellerCounter-currentOffer)*0.5),Math.max(0,protectedMao-currentOffer)); nextOffer=Math.min(protectedMao,currentOffer+concession); decision=nextOffer>=sellerCounter?'accept_or_contract':'controlled_concession'; action=nextOffer>=sellerCounter?'accept_counter_and_prepare_contract':'send_revised_offer';}} else {decision=risk==='high'||risk==='critical'?'human_review':'reprice_or_walk_away';action=risk==='high'||risk==='critical'?'escalate_to_human':'decline_above_mao';flags.push('counter_above_protected_mao');}} else if(currentOffer>0&&protectedMao>0&&currentOffer<=protectedMao){decision='initial_offer';action='present_or_follow_up_on_offer';nextOffer=currentOffer;} else {decision='prepare_offer';action='generate_protected_offer';nextOffer=protectedMao;} if(round>=maxRounds&&decision==='controlled_concession'){decision='human_review';action='final_negotiation_review';flags.push('max_rounds_reached');} const nextEvent=decision==='contract_ready'?'contract_readiness':decision==='send_revised_offer'?'revised_offer':decision==='accept_or_contract'?'contract_readiness':decision==='reengage_later'?'reengagement':'none'; return [{json:{...input,canonicalNegotiation:{decision,action,nextOffer:Math.max(0,nextOffer),protectedMao,currentOffer,sellerCounteroffer:sellerCounter,negotiationRound:round,maxNegotiationRounds:maxRounds,motivationScore:motivation,riskLevel:risk,negotiationGap:gap,maoUtilization:utilization,flags,nextEvent,requiresHumanReview:decision==='human_review',confidenceScore:protectedMao>0?85:40},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.purpose: Canonical production boundary combining seller offer strategy, response/counteroffer evaluation, controlled concessions, negotiation rounds and contract-readiness routing. Historical WF-373 through WF-414 and WF-437 through WF-461 are reference implementations.
